historicalBehavior: Accepted historical regular-file bytes and digests remain unchanged. Nonregular trusted manifest, descriptor and role inputs now refuse before synchronous reads instead of potentially blocking. stat/read verification relies on stable operator-owned state; it is not concurrent-write isolation.
fixture: Every current fixture carries the actual bundled runtime-pinned lint launcher. Other roles are minimal valid byte fixtures; these tests verify identity and preflight, not a complete executable package or a producer flip.
trust: The trusted caller creates frozen LintRuntime independently from provider selection. Current preflight reuses it for both owned probes and checks its cwd plus all installed physical assets after actual root discovery. Git, frozen PATH and its origin remain trusted stable prerequisites, not a general Git sandbox.
